`8-106`: _🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Add a negative onCreate case for singleton name enforcement.** The suite validates `spec.matchImages` well, but it doesn’t assert rejection when `metadata.name` is not `cluster`. Since singleton-name enforcement is part of the CRD contract, adding this case will protect against validation regressions.
✅ Suggested test case ```diff tests: onCreate: + - name: Should reject CRIOCredentialProviderConfig with non-cluster name + initial: | + apiVersion: config.openshift.io/v1 + kind: CRIOCredentialProviderConfig + metadata: + name: not-cluster + spec: {} + expectedError: "metadata.name: Invalid value: \"not-cluster\": must be 'cluster'" ```

In `@config/v1/tests/criocredentialproviderconfigs.config.openshift.io/CRIOCredentialProviderConfig.yaml` around lines 8 - 106, Add a new negative test case in the onCreate section to validate singleton name enforcement for the CRIOCredentialProviderConfig resource. Create a test case similar to the existing negative validation cases (e.g., "Should reject matchImages with invalid characters") that attempts to create a CRIOCredentialProviderConfig with metadata.name set to something other than "cluster" and include an expectedError that reflects the singleton name requirement. This will ensure that the validation rejects any name that is not "cluster" and prevent future regressions in singleton enforcement. ```
config/v1/types_crio_credential_provider_config.go (1)

Drop it, or set it to `1` if the intent was to require at least one property in `spec`.
♻️ Proposed change ```diff // CRIOCredentialProviderConfigSpec defines the desired configuration of the CRI-O Credential Provider. -// +kubebuilder:validation:MinProperties=0 type CRIOCredentialProviderConfigSpec struct { ```

If the intent was to require at least one property in the spec, replace it with `+kubebuilder:validation:MinProperties=1` instead; otherwise, simply delete the annotation line entirely. ```
payload-manifests/crds/0000_10_config-operator_01_criocredentialproviderconfigs.crd.yaml (1)
`211-212`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _💤 Low value_ **Storage version moved from `v1alpha1` to `v1` — confirm migration of any persisted objects.** After this change `v1` is the single storage version (`storage: true`) and `v1alpha1` becomes `storage: false`, which is the correct invariant. Since the storage version is switching, any objects previously persisted as `v1alpha1` will remain stored at that version until a storage migration runs, and `status.storedVersions` must converge to `v1` before `v1alpha1` can ever be removed. For this new TechPreview singleton there is likely no GA-persisted data, but please verify no in-cluster consumer still writes/reads `v1alpha1` and that a storage migration is planned. Schemas for both versions are identical, so identity conversion is sufficient. Based on learnings: replacing/changing a CRD version is acceptable only if all in-cluster consumers and tooling are switched over atomically and no consumer still references the removed/old version afterward. Also applies to: 407-407
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@payload-manifests/crds/0000_10_config-operator_01_criocredentialproviderconfigs.crd.yaml` around lines 211 - 212, The storage version has been moved from v1alpha1 to v1, which requires ensuring the v1alpha1 version definition has storage set to false (at the location also applies to line 407). Verify that all in-cluster consumers and tooling have been atomically switched to use the v1 version instead of v1alpha1 and confirm that no code or configurations still reference v1alpha1 for reads or writes. Additionally, ensure a storage migration plan exists to migrate any persisted v1alpha1 objects to v1 (note that since the schemas for both versions are identical, identity conversion can be used for this migration), and validate that status.storedVersions will converge to v1 before v1alpha1 can be removed in the future. ```
